title: Fake bank asks for an OTP to "unblock" the account
_tests: Breaks household rule 0 (the bank never asks for an OTP on a call). Same bank name as the genuine call 04.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is the security department of Gomti Bank. Your debit card has been blocked due to suspicious activity.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Blocked? I just got a new card.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes madam, someone is trying to withdraw money from it right now. To stop it, I am sending an OTP to your phone.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please read the OTP to me quickly, otherwise all your savings will be lost in ten minutes.
